about_the_game:
Survival means more than fighting back—it means becoming what you destroy. Swarms of enemies close in, but the only way forward is to hunt your target foe and claim their form. Each transformation grants new abilities and playstyles, while your former self vanishes from the battlefield… only to return as an enemy in the next stage.

Every run is a fresh test of adaptation. Experiment with upgrades, evolve through shifting abilities, and face the chaos of enemies that grow stronger as you do. From swift assassins to hulking brutes, every form opens new paths to survival. Can you master them all before the swarm consumes you?

Features

  • Transform to Survive – Become the very enemies that hunt you, gaining their powers and weaknesses.

  • Rogue-lite Progression – Collect upgrades, discover synergies, and push for stronger runs.

  • Evolving Challenge – Advance levels where your last form returns to test your skill.

  • Strategic Variety – Every enemy offers unique abilities and tactics to master.

• Weapon Upgrades
